text: 科创50指数半日涨超5%，半导体芯片股集体走强。 恒指半日涨0.11%，恒生科技指数、恒生生物科技指数涨超1%，MINIMAX涨超11%。 美伊协议预期升温，亚太股市走高，韩国首尔综指涨超4%，日经225指数涨超3%，油价跌逾1%。 美媒：霍尔木兹海峡开放临时协议“接近达成”。 特朗普称与伊朗的谈判进展顺利，未来48小时会有更多消息。 美国堪萨斯城联储主席施密德称需要收紧政策以降低通胀。 A股“易中天”集体回应美国光模块禁令。 报道：DeepSeek重启融资，投前估值5000亿元。 外商独资公募进军投顾？渠道人士：已有准备动作。
text_en: The STAR 50 Index rose over 5% in the morning session, with semiconductor chip stocks surging. The Hang Seng Index gained 0.11% in the morning, while the Hang Seng Tech Index and Hang Seng Biotech Index rose over 1%, and MINIMAX jumped over 11%. Asia-Pacific stocks climbed on expectations of a US-Iran deal, with Seoul's KOSPI up over 4% and the Nikkei 225 up over 3%, while oil fell more than 1%. US media reported that a temporary deal to open the Strait of Hormuz is 'close.' Trump said talks with Iran are progressing well, with more news in the next 48 hours. Kansas City Fed President Schmid said policy needs to be tightened to lower inflation. A-share 'Yi-Zhong-Tian' companies collectively responded to the US optical module ban. Reports said DeepSeek has restarted financing at a pre-investment valuation of RMB 500 billion. Foreign-owned mutual fund firms moving into investment advisory? Channel sources say preparatory steps have been taken.
